_note: Recorded on the reference machine (n8n 2.37.10, faster_whisper base int8 on CPU, llama3.2:3b).
`seed_clip_run` is what `python scripts/dev/run-workflow.py A03` produces out of the box, now that
seed/files/meeting-clip.wav carries real TTS speech: the quality gate passes and the AI lane runs.
Whisper's output on this clip is stable - three consecutive runs gave identical text and metrics.
`tone_fallback_run` is what the same command produced while the clip was still formant tones, and is
what a machine with no local TTS engine still gets (seed/generate_seed.py warns loudly when it falls back).
`asr-response.json` in this folder is the raw /asr body for the current clip, tokens stripped.

seed_clip_run.input: /home/node/.n8n-files/seed/meeting-clip.wav (66 s, 16 kHz mono, generated by seed/generate_seed.py via local TTS)
seed_clip_run.transcript_opening: Nadia. Morning everyone, quick stand up. Orders queue first. Karim, where are we? Karim. 12 orders are still stuck from the partner import. I will chase the corrected file today and rerun the import tomorrow morning.

tasks.title: Resolve stuck orders from partner import
Deploy uptime alerts
tasks.due_raw: before the end of the week

known_model_errors: Only three of the clip's four commitments are extracted: Nadia's own 'I will escalate the tax rates with finance today' is missed. That is llama3.2:3b, not the plumbing.
Whisper renders 'Leila' as 'Lila' and 'PDFs' as 'PDFS'; neither changes an owner or a due date, and 'Fix invoice PDFS support template' carries the artefact into the task title.
Owners ARE correct here, because every line is spoken with its speaker's name in front of it - Whisper does not diarise, so that spoken label is what makes attribution work.
The meeting date is 2026-09-07, a Monday, so 'by Friday' and 'before the end of the week' both resolve to 2026-09-11.

tone_fallback_run._when: The clip is the tone fallback: seed/generate_seed.py found no local TTS engine, or the pre-TTS seed is still in place.
tone_fallback_run.input: /home/node/.n8n-files/seed/meeting-clip.wav (30 s of formant-shaped syllables - NOT speech)
tone_fallback_run.transcript: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
tone_fallback_run.transcript_is_unstable: Whisper invents a different sentence each run: "This is what you want.", "I'm sorry." x5, "So Oh", ". . .", "I'm sorry." x3. Never assert on it - assert on the gate, which rejected every one.

missing_recording._when: Config.audio_file matches no file. Read/Write File is a glob, so this used to return zero items and finish green.
